name: o90233

schema.title: locationInfo
schema.description: Defines how location information will be retrieved from a [CSV](csvLayer.md) file referenced through the web, ie. referenced by URL.

latitudeFieldName.description: A string defining the field name that holds the latitude (Y) coordinate.

longitudeFieldName.description: A string defining the field name that holds the longitude (X) coordinate.

description:
The location data for this dataset is defined using geographic coordinates. Specifically, each record’s position is identified by a latitude value and a longitude value.

In the source CSV, the latitude values are stored under the column named **latitude**, while the corresponding longitude values are found in the column named **longitude**. This field configuration allows the system to interpret each point accurately as a set of coordinates.
